text_block_list.text: Okay, I think I'll get going.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: What did you three talk about?

text_block_list.text:
Nothing important. I think the last time
we met
was when we ate together a
couple of days ago.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We didn't talk about anything special
then either.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just how awful Ticket's test scores were
and how
annoyed Hayahide was with
Brian. Y'know, that
kinda stuff.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But I'm fine with that. I've never been
good at
making conversation anyway.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
